# `request-media-type-added`

Request media type added

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `request-media-type-added` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Request bodies ([RULES.md section 5](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A request body accepts an additional media type, e.g. `application/xml`.

## Why this default

Clients keep sending the media types they already use.

## Example

From test case [`request-media-type-added`](../../test/cases/request-media-type-added/): A new request media type.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
              schema:
                type: object
+           application/xml:
+             schema:
+               type: object
        responses:
          '200':
```

Findings:

- `request-media-type-added` · info · POST /pets

## Test cases

The example above is the only test case for this rule.


## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  request-media-type-added: info
```
